protocol.name: bifrost
protocol.description: BIFROST SDK Electron <-> Python backend IPC contract. Single source of truth for the desktop app bridge. v1.2 adds per-operation stream routing and cooperative cancellation. v1.3 adds the analyzer/decompiler surface (analyze, analyze_export, analyze_probe, decompile_fn) and the address explorer (analyzer_hexdump, analyzer_disasm_at, analyzer_xrefs).
notes: All new command/event changes must update this file first.
Streaming events carry a `stream` tag (the command name) used by main.js for per-operation channel routing.
Request-response correlation: Python echoes the request `id` as `_id`.

request_response.correlation: id field echoed in response as _id; envelope includes protocol_version

streaming.style: fire-and-forget with stream tag; cancellation via `cancel` command + shared CANCEL_EVENT
streaming.responses: arrive asynchronously via stdout as typed events tagged with `stream`
streaming.cancellation: renderer sends `cancel` {operation}; backend sets CANCEL_EVENT, operations abort at checkpoints and emit a result with code CANCELLED

error_shape.error: string (human readable message) — chosen for consistency with existing result/log payloads

ping.notes: Health check. Used by renderer to detect bridge liveness.

list_processes.response: {type:'result', data: array of {pid, name, window, engine}}
list_processes.notes: Returns filtered process list with engine annotation from KNOWN_GAME_EXES.

bridge_info.notes: Return live backend build signature + feature flags so the UI can verify which revision is running.

read_memory.response: {type:'result', data: {pid, address, size, bytes: [int]}} or {type:'result', data: {error, code}}
read_memory.notes: Raw process memory read for the Memory Viewer. Uses stealth access with direct fallback.

ac_detect.notes: Scans processes/services/drivers for known anti-cheat systems (eac, battleye, vanguard, ricochet, nprotect).

analyze_probe.response: {type:'result', data: {rizin: {available, exe, version, decompiler}, iced: {available}, default_engine}}
analyze_probe.notes: Reports decompiler engine availability. rizin+rz-ghidra when provisioned (tools/provision_rizin.ps1), iced-x86 otherwise. No rizin process spawned when missing.

args.addr: number (function address from an analyze result)

decompile_fn.response: {type:'result', data: {addr, code}} or {error, code: NO_SESSION | BAD_ARGS | DECOMPILE_FAILED}
decompile_fn.notes: Decompiles one function from the open rizin session (pdgj). Bodies cached; sessions idle-close after 5 minutes.

analyzer_hexdump.response: {type:'result', data: {addr, size, arch, rows:[{addr, hex, ascii}]}} or {error, code: NO_SESSION | BAD_ARGS | UNMAPPED | READ_FAILED}
analyzer_hexdump.notes: IDA-style hex+ascii dump at an address in the open image. Plain file read, no rizin spawn.

analyzer_disasm_at.response: {type:'result', data: {addr, arch, lines:[{address, bytes, text}]}} or {error, code: NO_SESSION | BAD_ARGS | UNMAPPED | DISASM_FAILED}
analyzer_disasm_at.notes: Linear disassembly at an address (iced-x86, rizin-free) for the address explorer.

analyzer_xrefs.response: {type:'result', data: {addr, xrefs:[{from, type, op}]}} or {error, code: NO_SESSION | BAD_ARGS | NO_RIZIN | XREFS_FAILED}
analyzer_xrefs.notes: Cross-references to an address via rizin axtj. One-shot spawn, ~seconds.

analyzer_symbols.response: {type:'result', data: {count, symbols: {<name>: <addr>}, engine}} or {error, code: NO_SESSION | SYMBOLS_FAILED}
analyzer_symbols.notes: Full function name -> addr map for the open session. Powers clickable function identifiers in decompiled C. Collected during analyze; lazy aflj refetch if the map was cleared.

analyzer_strings.response: {type:'result', data: {count, min_len, strings:[{addr, offset, size, enc, text}]}} or {error, code: NO_SESSION | BAD_ARGS | UNMAPPED | READ_FAILED}
analyzer_strings.notes: IDA strings-window equivalent: whole-image scan for ASCII + UTF-16LE runs, mapped to VAs. Pure file read, no rizin spawn.

args.include_threads: boolean (default false) — faulthandler thread dump of the backend process

debug_snapshot.response: {type:'result', data: {current: {cmd, meta, stage, pct, idle_s, ring[]} | null, last: {.., outcome, duration}, target: {pid, name, running}, output: [{path, size, mtime}], known_engines: [string], threads?: string}} or {error, code: SNAPSHOT_FAILED}
debug_snapshot.notes: Operation diagnostics. Answers 'is the op stuck or dead?': active op idle time, last events ring, target process liveness, output dir contents, optional full thread dump. New dump results with 0 classes fail loud with code EMPTY_DUMP instead of silent success.

cancel.notes: Sets the shared CANCEL_EVENT. Streaming operations abort at their next checkpoint.

dump.notes: Long-running. Triggers run_dump in gui_bridge -> engine dumper. Cancellable via CANCEL_EVENT.

analyze.notes: Opens a binary for analysis. rizin session stays open for decompile_fn; module sources are dumped raw to output/analyzer/<module>/ first (hijack -> direct attach only, never a kernel driver).

analyze_export.notes: Batch-decompiles the open session's largest functions to .c files in <source dir>/decomp/. Cancellable between functions.

payload.stream: string (operation tag; set by api_server on streaming emits)

log.routing: main.js routes by stream tag to <op>-log; level=error additionally to <op>-error

progress.routing: main.js routes by stream tag to <op>-progress
progress.notes: Used by all four streaming operations.

payload.data: object (operation-specific result shape; on failure {error, code})

result.routing: main.js routes by stream tag to <op>-complete; on data.error also to <op>-error

error.notes: Dedicated error event emitted on backend crash/interrupt by main.js.

known_limitations.no_auth_on_stdio_channel: The stdio channel is trust-by-launch (parent spawns child). Version envelopes + command allow-list are enforced; full mutual attestation is out of scope.
known_limitations.cancel_is_cooperative: cancel sets CANCEL_EVENT; operations abort at checkpoints (scanner chunks, between dump stages), not instantly mid-read.
known_limitations.streaming_has_no_timeout: Only request-response commands have the 15s timeout in sendCommand.
known_limitations.result_shape_inconsistency: Bridge returns {headers, json: string path, classes: count, fields: count, ...}. Many UI pages expect an in-memory .classes array of full objects. Consumers must load the json path themselves.
known_limitations.admin_elevation_is_all_or_nothing: requireAdministrator in the manifest with limited runtime graceful handling.
known_limitations.dual_bundler_staleness_risk: api_server.exe is a separate PyInstaller artifact; changes to gui_bridge / engines require rebuild + copy. Mitigated by build.ps1 + smoke gate.

validation_points: api_server.py: process_command validates command against the allow-list before dispatch
main.js: sendCommand/sendStreamingCommand emit envelopes containing protocol_version
All error responses conform to error_shape above
enforcement.next_steps: See plan.md for the council remediation history and verification gates.

current_implementation_references.main_command_and_streaming: gui/electron/main.js (sendCommand, sendStreamingCommand, ipc handlers, stream routing)
current_implementation_references.bridge_command_handlers: gui_bridge.py (run_dump, run_spoof*, run_read_memory, run_ac_detect, cancel_operation, KNOWN_GAME_EXES)
